openalex.disabled_reason: OpenAlex API requires an API key under the current 2026 access model; the production freeze is Crossref-only unless an explicit authenticated provider contract is added before screening.

retention_rule: Retain a deduplicated Crossref record if either (a) title/abstract contains a frozen nectar-larceny text stem after retrieval by a frozen CORE_LARCENY discovery query, or (b) it is a known direct-study DOI retrieved through the separately declared exact-DOI calibration lookup. The exact-DOI calibration is fixed from study identity only, includes all directions, and never uses effect direction. Geometry flags remain priority annotations and do not exclude records.
deduplication_rule: otherwise normalized title plus publication year
formal_inference_gate: No recurrence statistic may open unless the frozen core-larceny discovery frame remains below the per-query cap, the separate exact-DOI known-study calibration passes the recall gate, every retained candidate is screened under the pre-existing geometry contract, duplicates are resolved, and exclusions are recorded.
